subject: Hello
author: Mad Wookiee11
body:
The F1 car is the last one you get to takedown on the roads.  I got it with around 25 challenges left offline, but it varys depending on the challenges you do.  When you do the burning route, you get the PCPD special, which is the most popular racing car on the game.  You can use the sponsor codes if you want to get the wal mart car which is just like it if you are American.
